presentation.label: Urinary symptoms
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us about your symptoms and when they started.

questions.question: Are you experiencing pain when passing urine?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate there is pain when passing urine?

questions.question: Are you needing to pass urine more frequently than usual?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient is passing urine more frequently than usual?

questions.question: Are you waking in the night needing to pass urine?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient is waking at night needing to pass urine?

questions.question: Have you felt like you have had a fever during this episode?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate there is fever in this episode?

questions.question: Do you have any pain in your sides or back, below your ribs?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has pain in their sides or back below the ribs, suggesting flank pain?

questions.question: Have you noticed any blood in your urine?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has noticed blood in their urine?

questions.question: Have you had a urine infection in the last 30 days?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has had a urine infection in the last 30 days?

urgent_urinary_symptoms.message: Some of your symptoms suggest you may need to be seen urgently. Please call the surgery and ask to speak to the duty doctor instead of sending an online form.
